description: Draw a Fibonacci study directly on the chart with exact candle coordinates and optional custom ratios. Supports retracement, extension, channel, time, fan, circle, spiral, arc and wedge variants. Prefer swing timestamps/prices returned by market_candles computations rather than visual guesses. For a highest-high/lowest-low retracement use anchorMode high-to-low or low-to-high with ref and lookback: the tool selects exact CLOSED-candle wick coordinates. Do not substitute window start/end times. Changes the chart you are building; finish with chart_link, or analysis_prepare for a sharing draft that needs human review.

anchorMode.description: Default explicit uses points. Automatic modes support fibRetracement only and require ref.

color.description: A palette name. “up” and “down” are the reserved green and red — they assert a bullish or bearish claim, so use them for position zones and not for a measurement.

lookback.description: Number of most recent CLOSED bars for automatic anchors. Load at least this many closed bars first.

opacity.description: Strength of the whole drawing, 0.1 to 1. Fade a level that is context rather than the decision.

name: fibonacci_draw
